caseNameFull: Aqua Hotel Corp. v. McLaughlin, Trustee in Reorganization
attorneys: Morris Lavine for petitioners., Calvin C. Magleby for Levy, and Thomas S. Tobin for Weiler, respondents.

opinions.text: The motion to strike the brief of intervenor is denied. The motion to substitute Harry C. Levy, present Trustee in Bankruptcy of the Estate of the Aqua Hotel Corporation, as a party respondent in the place and stead of Sydney H. Kaye, removed, is granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.
